master.title: Materials Today: Proceedings
master.content:
The proceedings contain 104 papers. The topics discussed include: production of biofuel and bioplastic from chlorella pyrenoidosa; mechanical and sorption behaviour of organo-modified montmorillonite nanocomposites based on EPDM - NBR blends; high pressure study on structural, electronic and elastic properties of calcium chalcogenides, CaX (X = S,Se) by first principles calculations; design, simulation and fabrication of a normally-closed microvalve based on magnetic actuation; dry sliding wear behavior of pultruded glass fiber epoxy composites: effect of temperature; synthesis of boron nitride nanotubes and boron nitride nanoflakes with potential application in bioimaging; the computation of displacement damage cross sections of silicon, carbon and silicon carbide for high energy applications; finite element analysis of tool particle interaction, particle volume fraction, size, shape and distribution in machining of A356/SiCp; gravimetric and electrochemical study of temperature effect of PVA grafted terpolymer on corrosion inhibition of mild steel in hydrochloric acid; experimental investigations on deformation, densification and mechanical properties of sintered Fe-C-Mn low alloy P/M steels under hot upsetting; paper based microfluidic device for the detection of total protein in blood; and evaluation of properties of glass ionomer cement reinforced with zinc oxide nanoparticles - an in vitro study.

candidate.title: Materials Today: Proceedings
candidate.content:
The proceedings contain 73 papers. The topics discussed include: mechanical strengthening effect by various forms and orientation of glass fiber reinforced isopthalic polyester polymer composite; experimental investigations on static and dynamic parameters of steel and composite propeller shafts with an integrated metallic joints; review on wear characteristics of aluminum silicon carbide reinforced with basalt fiber; machinability studies of aerospace steel using hot end milling; impact characterization of epoxy LY556/ricinus communis L plant natural fiber composite materials; effect of annealing on silver oxide nano particle generated by electrochemical discharge machining; and preparation characterisation of alumina nanocomposites.
